name: turn: the model writes one sentence that takes nine seconds to say ("Next, scroll down to Submitting the Application, which says ...") and one that names a code and has no place to cut: the first is said as two sentences, "It says ..." the second, and its card holds both; the one with the code is said whole

beats.say: Next, scroll down to Submitting the Application, which says the designated officer submits everything on EngageSC from a laptop or desktop.
The Academic Notice section says an RNR01 hold goes on when your cumulative GPA drops below 2.0.
